<description>
Part of #36692. This replaces the field-by-field construction of transaction inputs and outputs in `multisig_tests` with `COutPoint`, `CTxIn` and `CTxOut` constructor calls.

It keeps `CMutableTransaction` as the builder, since a `CTransaction` constructor taking inputs and outputs directly is still under discussion (#36696). If one is added, the `vin`/`vout` lists here can be passed to it directly.

This change is test-only and does not change the constructed transactions:

- The funding outputs were previously created by `vout.resize(3)` and only had their `scriptPubKey` assigned, leaving `nValue` at its null value (`-1`). The `-1` is now spelled out explicitly, which makes this previously hidden value visible
- The loop index is changed from `int` to `uint32_t` to match `COutPoint::n`
</description>

<commits>
c723c37de6 test: construct multisig_tests inputs/outputs declaratively

Replace the field-by-field construction of the inputs and outputs in
multisig_verify and multisig_Sign with COutPoint, CTxIn and CTxOut
constructor calls.

The funding outputs were previously created by vout.resize(3) and only
had their scriptPubKey assigned, leaving nValue null (-1). The -1 is
now spelled out explicitly so the transactions are unchanged.

The loop index is changed to uint32_t to match COutPoint::n, as
brace-initialization does not allow the narrowing conversion from int.
</commits>
